figures.caption: Figure 9.8 displays streamlines for some typical flows. For example, Fig. 9.8(a) describes a laminar flow where the velocities at different points in the fluid may have different magnitudes
Fig. 9.9 The flow of an ideal fluid in a pipe of varying cross section. The fluid in a section of length v1∆t moves to the section of length v2∆t in time ∆t.
